svg.title: Fabric + Foundry IQ platform architecture
svg.desc: GitHub, Copilot and Terraform prepare a Fabric and Foundry DEV baseline. Fabric contains a shared capacity, DEV and initially empty TEST workspaces, a GitHub credentials connection and a native deployment pipeline. The Bootstrap plan runs seed and binding notebooks. Azure AI Search hosts the Foundry IQ knowledge base with indexed OneLake files and optional live Fabric ontology sources. Foundry supplies chat and embedding models, a project and Search/MCP connections. Entra deployment authentication, managed identities and an additional runtime user token have distinct responsibilities. Consuming apps and agents are not provisioned.
svg.text: One repository. A seeded DEV workspace. Two complementary knowledge paths.
One host, tfvars file and state
Review and approve each saved plan
Git sync and notebooks: outside Terraform
Azure resource group: capacity, Foundry and Search
Capacity shared by DEV and TEST
Created only after DEV IDs are known
Microsoft Entra | separate deployment and runtime identities
Deploy: Entra app + delegated scopes; administrator consent, then user sign-in.
Index: Search managed identity is Contributor on DEV only. Runtime: project identity authenticates to Search.
Live ontology retrieval also needs an end-user Search-audience token in x-ms-query-source-authorization.
*App tooling is separate from platform deployment. PROD, consuming agents and real ingestion are project-owned.
